description:
We are a team of enthusiastic students interested in AI, technology, space exploration, and creative problem-solving. Although we are beginners in coding, we are eager to learn, collaborate, and turn our ideas into a working project. We want to participate in this hackathon to gain practical experience, explore new technologies, and build something useful and innovative.

If you enjoy solving problems, sharing ideas, and learning together, we'd love to have you on our team.
